name: Amplitude
description: Amplitude positions itself as bringing "AI into every step of building self-improving products," combining product analytics, feedback, experimentation, and feature management.
best_for: Positioned for product, data, engineering, marketing, and executive teams at companies from startups (free tier) to enterprises, across financial services, B2B SaaS, media, healthcare, and ecommerce.
features: Product analytics and web analytics with instant query results
"360-Journeys" view of user actions across the full customer journey
AI-powered feedback analysis and 400+ partner integrations

pricing.starting_price: Free: $0 for 2M events/month; Plus starts at $0 and scales with event volume

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 2 million events/month forever, unlimited seats, no credit card required.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: First 2 million events/month are free; paid usage scales with event volume up to 70 million events.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Custom event-based pricing; adds advanced analytics, SSO, project permissions, and higher limits.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom event-based pricing; adds advanced security, user management, RBAC, support, and custom retention.

cons: The Free plan is capped at 2 million events per month; repeated overages can block account access, and continued overages without upgrading can ultimately lead to account deletion under Amplitude's documented policy.
Plus pricing becomes usage-based as event volume grows, while Growth and Enterprise pricing is custom and advanced features can require higher plans or add-ons.

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.

alternatives.name: Heap
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform that automatically captures every user interaction without manual event tagging.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams wanting automatic data capture for conversion and retention analysis.
